purpose: Field registry for the Artifact Correction Layer 2 method-selection evidence package.

fields.name: Tool Name
fields.definition: Canonical method or tool identity in the frozen topic candidate set.
fields.fill_rule: Use the canonical method name from the frozen input JSON.
fields.topic_relevance: Defines the row identity and candidate freeze.

fields.name: Method Family
fields.definition: Short algorithm-family label for the artifact-correction approach.
fields.fill_rule: Use a concise family phrase from the Layer 1 registry and verified method evidence.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates probabilistic contamination correction, image illumination correction, and molecular-neighborhood factorization.

fields.name: Main Input
fields.definition: High-level input object or signal used by the method in this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use object-level input phrasing rather than parameters or commands.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes spot-count matrices, sparse image volumes, and post-segmentation molecular assignments.

fields.name: Main Use in This Topic
fields.definition: Main role of the method inside Artifact Correction.
fields.fill_rule: Describe only the artifact-correction role; do not foreground unrelated downstream analyses.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps each method scoped to the artifact it corrects.

fields.name: Main Output
fields.definition: High-level output object relevant to artifact correction.
fields.fill_rule: Use a short object-level phrase such as corrected count matrix, corrected image field, or molecular-admixture correction output.
fields.topic_relevance: Shows whether the method changes expression counts, image-derived inputs, or cell-level molecular assignments.

fields.name: Closest Alternatives
fields.definition: Nearby alternatives from the same frozen topic set.
fields.fill_rule: Use local alternatives only. When the frozen set has no same-artifact alternative, name the closest cross-artifact comparators and note the difference in Key Difference.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports local comparison without adding methods or creating global rankings.

fields.name: Key Difference
fields.definition: Main decision difference versus nearby alternatives.
fields.fill_rule: Use one decision-level sentence grounded in artifact type, input signal, or correction stage.
fields.topic_relevance: Feeds branch-local method-selection logic.

fields.name: Compute Requirement
fields.definition: Coarse compute requirement.
fields.fill_rule: Use the coarse label supported by the registry or direct method evidence; do not infer runtime readiness.
fields.topic_relevance: Acts as a coarse resource cue for later audit triage.

fields.name: Memory Burden
fields.definition: Coarse memory burden.
fields.fill_rule: Use low, medium, high, or unclear. Prefer unclear when direct public support is weak.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps resource uncertainty visible without over-labeling.

fields.name: Scale Sensitivity
fields.definition: Coarse sensitivity to larger slides, many images, or high-density molecule/cell assignments.
fields.fill_rule: Use low, medium, high, or unclear. Be conservative unless public evidence directly supports a label.
fields.topic_relevance: Highlights possible scaling risk while avoiding unsupported performance claims.

fields.name: Code Access
fields.definition: Current code-access state.
fields.fill_rule: Record access state only; do not equate code access with BioHarness runtime support.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports later representative Layer 3/4 audit triage.

fields.name: Primary Code Link
fields.definition: One primary code or official documentation location.
fields.fill_rule: Fill only when an official or clearly primary code source is confirmed.
fields.topic_relevance: Provides a traceable public code source for later engineering review.

fields.name: Evidence Source
fields.definition: Main evidence basis for the row.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled source label.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes direct method-paper evidence from review or synthesized evidence.

fields.name: Evidence Note
fields.definition: Short note on direct evidence and Layer 2 synthesized judgment.
fields.fill_rule: Use one to two concise sentences. Mark comparison, burden, scale, and risk fields as synthesized when appropriate.
fields.topic_relevance: Makes evidence strength and uncertainty visible.

fields.name: Best First Choice When
fields.definition: Best-fit starting condition within this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use one positive conditional sentence. Do not write default-method claims.
fields.topic_relevance: Feeds conditional branch-local method selection.

fields.name: Do Not Start With This When
fields.definition: Main condition where this method should not be the first method read or trialed.
fields.fill_rule: Use one concise exclusion sentence.
fields.topic_relevance: Prevents cross-artifact misuse without claiming runtime failure.

fields.name: Artifact Target
fields.definition: Primary artifact class the method is intended to correct.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value representing the dominant artifact target.
fields.topic_relevance: This is the first branch point because the three frozen candidates address different artifact mechanisms.

fields.name: Assay / Modality Cue
fields.definition: Coarse assay or data-modality setting implied by the artifact-correction method.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value. Use unclear when the public source does not support a tighter modality cue.
fields.topic_relevance: Guards against using a correction model outside the assay family where the artifact arises.

fields.name: Correction Stage
fields.definition: Pipeline stage at which the correction conceptually acts.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value for the dominant correction stage.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates corrections applied before spot calling, after count construction, and after cell segmentation.

fields.name: Output Alteration Level
fields.definition: Level at which the method changes or annotates the data object.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value for the primary output alteration.
fields.topic_relevance: Clarifies whether downstream users should expect changed counts, changed image-derived inputs, or molecular-assignment correction output.

fields.name: Primary Downstream Risk Addressed
fields.definition: Primary downstream analysis risk described by the method evidence or inferred from the artifact mechanism.
fields.fill_rule: Use concise free text; distinguish direct paper claims from Layer 2 synthesis in Evidence Note.
fields.topic_relevance: Connects artifact correction to downstream scientific failure modes without ranking methods globally.

fields.name: Scientific Caution
fields.definition: Concise caveat about evidence strength, artifact specificity, possible bias, or benchmark limitations.
fields.fill_rule: Use conservative free text. Do not convert the caveat into a severity score.
fields.topic_relevance: Carries scientific-critical-thinking concerns into the decision tree.
